run_greeter_client: run the gRPC helloworld Greeter client to send a SayHello request and print the response
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to localhost:50051 using grpc.insecure_channel
create_greeter_stub: create a GreeterStub from a gRPC channel to call SayHello RPC methods
send_sayhello_request: send a SayHello request with a name to the GreeterStub and receive a response message
review_run_function: review the run function that connects to a gRPC server and calls SayHello
